summary: Reserve a reviewed immutable delivery receipt contract outside disposable notice snapshots.

replay.detail: The receipt namespace is reserved before receipt admission is enabled. Generic custom data under it is not authorized delivery evidence and stays hidden.

schema.detail: Add the compiled pinned creation-only attention.notice-receipt v1 manifest, custom/attention/receipt/ subjects and custom.attention.receipt-created kind. Receipt structure binds source creation, producer, person recipient, opaque owner declaration hash, adapter surface and delivered/failed evidence. It has no runtime field or update claim.

rules.detail: Structural validation authenticates nothing by itself. Durable receipt authorization is a separate fail-closed owner-incarnation causal-position check; a runtime designation, old declaration hash or payload timestamp is not a substitute.

compatibility.detail: Roots, ancestors, descendants and claim kinds are reserved together, including alternate-prefix squats. Generic list/detail reads do not expose receipts. This internal contract registers no native API operation or capability.

manual.detail: There is no supported receipt history to migrate.

recovery.detail: Missing receipt authorization means delivery unknown. Snapshot reconstruction must not invent delivered status or trigger automatic redelivery.
